examples.arabic: هذه قصة جميلة عن عائلة صغيرة.
examples.english: This is a beautiful story about a small family.
examples.storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

examples.arabic: العمل كثير ولكن العائلة سعيدة جدا
examples.english: The work is a lot but the family is very happy
examples.transliteration: Al amal kathir wa lakin al aila saida jiddan

examples.arabic: المعتقدات المختلفة لا تفرق هذه العائلة المحبة أبدا.
examples.english: The different beliefs do not divide this loving family at all.
examples.transliteration: Almutaqadat almukhtalifa la tufarriq hadhihi alaila almuhibba abadan.

examples.arabic: تجتمع العائلة حول المائدة الكبيرة وتملا رائحة الطعام اللذيذ المكان
examples.english: The family gathers around the large table and the smell of delicious food fills the place.
examples.transliteration: Tajtamiu al aila hawla al maida al kabira wa tamla raihat at taam al ladhidh al makan

examples.english: The evening was beautiful with the family.
The whole family is happy for this day.
